services.name: 36 Hour Deep Sea Tuna Trip CAPT. JOHN
services.desc: Rates Anglers (Ages 13+) - $425 About Our 36 hour trips are the ultimate off-shore experience! Our trip takes you out to bottom fish reefs and structures in 150- 400 ft of water for a variety of deep water species such as types of snapper, grouper, amberjack and more. At night we fish floating oil platforms over 120 miles offshore for yellow and black fin tuna. Our second day we bottom fish again before it is time to head for home.
